nodes.label: GES
nodes.definition: 品牌方向其下游渠道客户（如经销商、零售商等）开票或确认销售的不含增值税（或其他销售税）的商品总金额；直取KE24的Gross sales Price Li 、 Last Min Adjustmt L5，二者汇总，即KE24销售基价金额 + 最后调整金额（L5）
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[2]

nodes.label: NGS
nodes.definition: 品牌方向下游渠道客户（如经销商、零售商等）销售商品所确认的未税销售收入，在此基础上扣除促销价格折扣、固定价格折扣、赠品及其他发票折扣后的净额；销售金额未税 - 发票折扣金额未税。其中，销售金额来自KE24的销售基价金额与L5调整；发票折扣为促销折扣、固定价格折扣、赠品金额及其他L6a之和，来源于KE24，并纳入KE30未分配销售组织的L6a调整。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[3]

nodes.label: GS
nodes.definition: 向渠道客户实现的已扣除促销价格折扣、固定价格折扣等L6a调整项后的销售收入含税总额。；净销额未税 ×（1 + 税率）；净销额由KE24销售金额扣除KE24及KE30发票折扣得到
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[4]

nodes.label: PPD
nodes.definition: 因促销活动给予客户的价格折扣未税金额。；汇总KE24促销价格折扣金额后取反数，作为未税促销折扣。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[40]

nodes.label: PLD
nodes.definition: 按固定价格条款给予客户的折扣未税金额。；汇总KE24固定价格折扣金额后取反数，作为未税固定价格折扣。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[41]

nodes.label: FG金额
nodes.definition: 免费品所对应的未税促销折扣金额，用于衡量赠品投入。；汇总KE24免费品促销折扣金额后取反数，作为未税赠品金额。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[42]

nodes.label: L6a Others
nodes.definition: 除单列促销折扣、固定折扣及赠品之外的其他发票内折扣未税金额。；KE24其他发票折扣 + KE30未分配销售组织的L6a金额。KE24部分先将L6a最后调整取负，与其他折扣项目相加，再对合计取反；完整费用清单见计算口径。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[43]

nodes.label: L6a
nodes.definition: 在发票内扣减的促销、固定价格、赠品及其他折扣的未税合计。；促销价格折扣 + 固定价格折扣 + 赠品金额 + 其他L6a；前三项来自KE24，其他L6a含KE24项目和KE30未分配销售组织调整。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[44]

nodes.label: L6b
nodes.definition: 发票外折扣金额未税；不含退货准备金的L6b + 退货准备金；两者由KE24费用项目计算，并包含其他L6b的KE30调整。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[82]

nodes.label: NES
nodes.definition: 外部净销售额未税；销售金额未税 - 发票折扣L6a - 发票外折扣L6b；销售金额来自KE24，折扣来自KE24及KE30调整。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[86]

nodes.label: GES Cons
nodes.definition: 企业向下游渠道客户（如经销商、代理商、连锁客户等）完成销售并确认出库（或开票）的商品总出货数量，以“支”为计量单位。；汇总KE24销售数量，统一按支计量。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[14]

nodes.label: FG Cons
nodes.definition: 品牌方向客户提供的免费品的数量，按最小销售单位“支”折算后的总出货数量。；总销售数量 ×（免费品促销折扣金额 ÷ 销售金额未税）；数量、免费品促销折扣和销售金额均来自KE24。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[15]

nodes.label: NGS Cons
nodes.definition: 除免费品外，按正常商务条款销售的常规商品的出货数量，统一折算为“支”后的总数量。；总销售数量 - 免费品销售数量；两者均依据KE24计算，单位为支。
nodes.evidence: DICT-M-20261011 指标与维度字典_粒度来源补充版_20261011.xlsx / 指标字典；行[16]

SQL10.sql:
-- 显示近3年洗护、染发、造型三大品类年累计SELL-IN销额及销额同比
-- 20210818优化：需要根据筛选器来展示销额/销量，枚举值字段也需要变更
-- YTD与时间筛选器挂钩，计算累积到 时间筛选器中勾选的时间周期中的最大一天，如勾选到今年最新一周，获取该周的最新一天，计算1.1到最新一天的所有数据，同理其他时间点以及时间类型
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数

SELECT
  -- nvl(t1.category_code,t2.category_code) AS category_code,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.category_code,t2.category_code),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.category_code,t2.category_code),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS category_code,
  nvl(t1.category_name,t2.category_name) AS category_name,
  -- nvl(t1.brand_code,t2.brand_code) AS brand_code,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.brand_code,t2.brand_code),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.brand_code,t2.brand_code),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS brand_code,
  nvl(t1.brand_name,t2.brand_name) AS brand_name,
  nvl(t1.product_line_code,t2.product_line_code) AS product_line_code,
  -- nvl(t1.product_line_name,t2.product_line_name) AS product_line_name,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.product_line_name,t2.product_line_name),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.product_line_name,t2.product_line_name),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS product_line_name,
  nvl(t1.mapping_time,t2.mapping_time) AS year,
  nvl(t1.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_now,
  nvl(t2.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_yoy
FROM
  (
  SELECT
    category_code,
    category_name,
    brand_code,
    brand_name,
    product_line_code,
    product_line_name,
    b.mapping_time,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
    inner join sell_in_mapping_time b 
  on a.day = b.time_now
    AND b.type = 'A.年'
    AND b.time_now <= (select max(time_now) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
  WHERE substr(a.day,5,4) <= (select substr(max(time_now),5,4) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    category_code,
    category_name,
    brand_code,
    brand_name,
    product_line_code,
    product_line_name,
    b.mapping_time 
  ) t1

  FULL JOIN 
    (
  SELECT
    category_code,
    category_name,
    brand_code,
    brand_name,
    product_line_code,
    product_line_name,
    b.mapping_time,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
    inner join sell_in_mapping_time b 
  on a.day = b.time_yoy
    and b.type = 'A.年'
    AND b.time_now <= (select max(time_now) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
  WHERE substr(a.day,5,4) <= (select substr(max(time_now),5,4) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    category_code,
    category_name,
    brand_code,
    brand_name,
    product_line_code,
    product_line_name,
    b.mapping_time 
  ) t2 
  ON nvl ( t1.category_code, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.category_code, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.category_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.category_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.brand_code, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.brand_code, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.brand_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.brand_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.product_line_code, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.product_line_code, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.product_line_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.product_line_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl(t1.mapping_time,1) = nvl(t2.mapping_time,1)     
  WHERE nvl(t1.mapping_time, t2.mapping_time) <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')

SELECT
  nvl(P1.mapping_time,P2.mapping_time) as mapping_time,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY nvl(P1.mapping_time,P2.mapping_time) DESC) DENSE_Rank ,
  -- nvl(P1.category_code,P2.category_code) AS category_code,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.category_code,P2.category_code),'_'，'Value')

SQL12.name: Sell_in总览_各渠道Sell_in销额
SQL12.sql:
-- 根据顶部筛选条件，显示四个渠道（NKA、Ecom、DT、WS）年累计SELL-IN销额及销额同比
-- 新增筛选器，可以筛选展示销额和销量
-- YTD与时间筛选器挂钩，计算累积到 时间筛选器中勾选的时间周期中的最大一天，如勾选到今年最新一周，获取该周的最新一天，计算1.1到最新一天的所有数据，同理其他时间点以及时间类型
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数

SELECT
  nvl(t1.first_channel_id,t2.first_channel_id) AS first_channel_id,
  -- nvl(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name) AS first_channel_name,
    case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
          when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
    else null end  AS first_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.second_channel_id,t2.second_channel_id) AS second_channel_id,
  -- nvl(t1.second_channel_name,t2.second_channel_name) AS second_channel_name,
    case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.second_channel_name,t2.second_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
          when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.second_channel_name,t2.second_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
    else null end  AS second_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.third_channel_id,t2.third_channel_id) AS third_channel_id,
  -- nvl(t1.third_channel_name,t2.third_channel_name) AS third_channel_name,
    case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.third_channel_name,t2.third_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
          when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(t1.third_channel_name,t2.third_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
    else null end  AS third_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.mapping_time,t2.mapping_time) AS year,
  nvl(t1.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_now,
  nvl(t2.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_yoy
FROM
  (
  SELECT
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    b.mapping_time,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
    left join sell_in_mapping_time b 
  on a.day = b.time_now
    AND b.type = 'A.年'
    AND b.time_now <= (select max(time_now) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
  WHERE substr(a.day,5,4) <= (select substr(max(time_now),5,4) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    b.mapping_time 
  ) t1

  FULL JOIN 
    (
  SELECT
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    b.mapping_time,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
    left join sell_in_mapping_time b 
  on a.day = b.time_yoy
    AND b.type = 'A.年'
    AND b.time_now <= (select max(time_now) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
  WHERE substr(a.day,5,4) <= (select substr(max(time_now),5,4) from sell_in_mapping_time WHERE ${mapping_time:mapping_time} AND ${type:type})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    b.mapping_time 
  ) t2 
  ON nvl ( t1.first_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.first_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.first_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.first_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.second_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.second_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.second_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.second_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.third_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.third_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.third_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.third_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl(t1.mapping_time,1) = nvl(t2.mapping_time,1)
WHERE nvl(t1.mapping_time, t2.mapping_time) <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y')

SQL13.name: Sell_in总览_各渠道销额趋势
SQL13.sql:
-- 根据顶部筛选条件，显示四个渠道（NKA、Ecom、DT、WS）所选截周期，历史滚动12个时间点的SELL-IN销额、销额同比
-- 新增筛选器，可以筛选展示销额和销量
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数

SELECT
  nvl(P1.mapping_time,p2.mapping_time) as mapping_time,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY nvl(p1.mapping_time,p2.mapping_time)  DESC) DENSE_Rank ,
  nvl(p1.first_channel_id,p2.first_channel_id) as first_channel_id,
  -- nvl(p1.first_channel_name,p2.first_channel_name) as first_channel_name,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.first_channel_name,P2.first_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.first_channel_name,P2.first_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS first_channel_name,
  nvl(p1.second_channel_id,p2.second_channel_id) as second_channel_id,
  -- nvl(p1.second_channel_name,p2.second_channel_name) as second_channel_name,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.second_channel_name,P2.second_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.second_channel_name,P2.second_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS second_channel_name,
  nvl(p1.third_channel_id,p2.third_channel_id) as third_channel_id,
  -- nvl(p1.third_channel_name,p2.third_channel_name) as third_channel_name,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.third_channel_name,P2.third_channel_name),'_'，'Value')
        when ${'2' : indexs} then concat(nvl(P1.third_channel_name,P2.third_channel_name),'_'，'Volume')  
  else null end  AS third_channel_name,
  p1.sku_ngs_amt as sku_ngs_amt_now,
  p2.sku_ngs_amt as sku_ngs_amt_yoy
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      t2.mapping_time,
      t1.first_channel_id,
      t1.first_channel_name,
      t1.second_channel_id,
      t1.second_channel_name,
      t1.third_channel_id,
      t1.third_channel_name,
      sum(
          case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
      ) as sku_ngs_amt
    FROM
      tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu t1
      LEFT JOIN sell_in_mapping_time t2 
      ON t1.day = t2.time_now
      AND ${t2.type:type}
      WHERE t1.day <= (select max(time_now) from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time}  AND ${type:type})
      AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
      AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
      AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
      AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
      AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
      AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
      AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
      AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
      AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
      AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
      AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
      GROUP BY 
        t2.mapping_time,
        t1.first_channel_id,
        t1.first_channel_name,
        t1.second_channel_id,
        t1.second_channel_name,
        t1.third_channel_id,
        t1.third_channel_name
  ) P1
  FULL JOIN (
    SELECT
      t2.mapping_time,
      t1.first_channel_id,
      t1.first_channel_name,
      t1.second_channel_id,
      t1.second_channel_name,
      t1.third_channel_id,
      t1.third_channel_name,
      sum(
          case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
      ) as sku_ngs_amt
    FROM
      tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu t1
      LEFT JOIN sell_in_mapping_time t2 
      ON t1.day = t2.time_yoy 
      AND ${t2.type:type}
      WHERE t1.day <= (select max(time_yoy) from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time}  AND ${type:type})
      AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
      AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
      AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
      AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
      AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
      AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
      AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
      AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
      AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
      AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
      AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
      GROUP BY 
        t2.mapping_time,
        t1.first_channel_id,
        t1.first_channel_name,
        t1.second_channel_id,
        t1.second_channel_name,
        t1.third_channel_id,
        t1.third_channel_name
  ) P2 
  ON nvl (p1.mapping_time, 1) = nvl (p2.mapping_time, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.first_channel_id, 1) = nvl (p2.first_channel_id, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.first_channel_name, 1) = nvl (p2.first_channel_name, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.second_channel_id, 1) = nvl (p2.second_channel_id, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.second_channel_name, 1) = nvl (p2.second_channel_name, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.third_channel_id, 1) = nvl (p2.third_channel_id, 1)
  AND nvl (p1.third_channel_name, 1) = nvl (p2.third_channel_name, 1)

SQL14.name: Sell_in总览_各客户Sell_in销额
SQL14.sql:
-- 展示不同层级客户sell-in销额及同比情况，其中客户层级包括四层，即Channel、区域、省份、Customer
-- 新增筛选器，可以筛选展示销额和销量
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数

SELECT
  nvl(t1.first_channel_id,t2.first_channel_id) as first_channel_id,
  nvl(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name) as first_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.second_channel_id,t2.second_channel_id) as second_channel_id,
  nvl(t1.second_channel_name,t2.second_channel_name) as second_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.third_channel_id,t2.third_channel_id) as third_channel_id,
  nvl(t1.third_channel_name,t2.third_channel_name) as third_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.fourth_channel_id,t2.fourth_channel_id) as fourth_channel_id,
  nvl(t1.fourth_channel_name,t2.fourth_channel_name) as fourth_channel_name,
  case  when ${'1' : indexs} then 'Sell_in Value'  
        when ${'2' : indexs} then 'Sell_in Volume'  else null end AS Measurement,
  nvl(t1.sku_ngs_amt,0) AS sku_ngs_amt_now,
  nvl(t2.sku_ngs_amt,0) AS sku_ngs_amt_yoy 
FROM
  (
  SELECT
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    fourth_channel_id,
    fourth_channel_name,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu 
  WHERE day in (select time_now from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time}) -- 获取本期的数据量
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND ${first_channel_name:first_channel_name}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    fourth_channel_id,
    fourth_channel_name 
  ) t1
  FULL JOIN (
  SELECT
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    fourth_channel_id,
    fourth_channel_name,
    sum(
        case when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'1' : indexs} and ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            when ${'2' : indexs} then sku_quantity_amt
            else 0 end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
  FROM
    tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu 
  WHERE day in (select time_yoy from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time}) -- 获取同期的数据量
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${first_channel_name:first_channel_name}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
  GROUP BY
    first_channel_id,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_id,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_id,
    third_channel_name,
    fourth_channel_id,
    fourth_channel_name 
  ) t2 
    ON nvl ( t1.first_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.first_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.first_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.first_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.second_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.second_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.second_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.second_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.third_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.third_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.third_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.third_channel_name, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.fourth_channel_id, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.fourth_channel_id, 1 ) 
  AND nvl ( t1.fourth_channel_name, 1 ) = nvl ( t2.fourth_channel_name, 1 )

SQL16.name: Sell_in总览_增量来源产品维度
SQL16.sql:
-- 20210511修改需求，其他增量占比逻辑原为：1-新品增量占比-核心产品线增量占比，修改为先计算其他的增量 /全体增量
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数
-- 新品增量占比：所选维度下新品销售额增长量／所选维度下整体增量 * 100%，新品为入市6个月内的产品。
-- 核心产品线增量占比：所选维度下核心产品线产品增量／所选维度下整体增量 * 100%；核心产品线指排除新品后，去年年累计POS未稅销额贡献占80%的产品线。
-- 其他增量占比：（整体增量 - 新品增量 - 核心产品线增量）/ 所选维度下整体增量 * 100%。

SELECT
    p1.category_p,
    nvl(p1.brand_code,p2.brand_code) as brand_code ,
    nvl(p1.brand_name,p2.brand_name) as brand_name ,
    nvl(p1.product_line_name,p2.product_line_name) as product_line_name,
    nvl ( p1.new_product, 0 ) - nvl ( p2.new_product, 0 ) AS new_product_increment， -- 新品增量
    nvl ( p1.core_product_line, 0 ) - nvl ( p2.core_product_line, 0 ) AS core_product_line_increment， -- 核心线增量
    nvl ( p1.total_amt, 0 ) - nvl ( p2.total_amt, 0 ) AS total_amt_increment, -- 全体增量
    (nvl(p1.total_amt,0) - nvl(p2.total_amt,0)) - (nvl(p1.core_product_line,0) - nvl(p2.core_product_line,0)) - (nvl(p1.new_product, 0) - nvl(p2.new_product,0)) AS Others_increment   -- 其他增量（全体增量 - 新品增量 -核心品增量）
FROM
    (
    SELECT
        t2.category_p, 
        t1.brand_code,
        t1.brand_name,
        t1.product_line_name,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code = 1 and ${'1':curr_type} THEN sku_ngs_amt
            WHEN t1.new_product_code = 1 and ${'2':curr_type} THEN ges
            ELSE 0 END 
            ) AS new_product,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code <> 1 AND t1.core_product_line_code = 1 and ${'1':curr_type} THEN sku_ngs_amt 
            WHEN t1.new_product_code <> 1 AND t1.core_product_line_code = 1 and ${'2':curr_type} THEN ges 
            ELSE 0 END 
            ) AS core_product_line,
        SUM( 
            case when ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            end
            ) AS total_amt 
        -- SUM( CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code = 1 THEN sku_ngs_amt ELSE 0 END ) AS new_product,
        -- SUM( CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code <> 1 AND t1.core_product_line_code = 1 THEN sku_ngs_amt ELSE 0 END ) AS core_product_line,
        -- SUM( sku_ngs_amt ) AS total_amt 
    FROM
        tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu t1
        LEFT JOIN (
            select category_code category_p, concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,'')) as category_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,''))
            union all 
            select 'ALL' category_p, concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,'')) as category_name  -- category_name不唯一，一个name对应多个code，所以要拼接
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,''))
        ) t2 
    ON concat(nvl(T1.category_code,''),nvl(T1.category_name,'')) = t2.category_name 
    WHERE
        day IN ( SELECT time_now FROM sell_in_mapping_time WHERE  ${mapping_time:mapping_time} ) 
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${t1.sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{t1.category_code,t1.brand_code,t1.product_line_name,t1.sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{t1.category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
    GROUP BY
        t2.category_p, 
        t1.brand_code,
        t1.brand_name,
        t1.product_line_name
    ) p1
    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        t2.category_p, 
        t1.brand_code,
        t1.brand_name,
        t1.product_line_name,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code = 1 and ${'1':curr_type} THEN sku_ngs_amt
            WHEN t1.new_product_code = 1 and ${'2':curr_type} THEN ges
            ELSE 0 END 
            ) AS new_product,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN t1.new_product_code <> 1 AND t1.core_product_line_code = 1 and ${'1':curr_type} THEN sku_ngs_amt 
            WHEN t1.new_product_code <> 1 AND t1.core_product_line_code = 1 and ${'2':curr_type} THEN ges 
            ELSE 0 END 
            ) AS core_product_line,
        SUM( 
            case when ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            end
            ) AS total_amt 
    FROM
        tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu t1
        LEFT JOIN (
            select category_code category_p, concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,'')) as category_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,''))
            union all 
            select 'ALL' category_p, concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,'')) as category_name 
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by concat(nvl(category_code,''),nvl(category_name,''))
        ) t2 
    ON concat(nvl(T1.category_code,''),nvl(T1.category_name,'')) = t2.category_name 
    WHERE
        day IN ( SELECT time_mom FROM sell_in_mapping_time WHERE  ${mapping_time:mapping_time} ) 
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${t1.sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{t1.category_code,t1.brand_code,t1.product_line_name,t1.sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{t1.category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
    GROUP BY
    t2.category_p, 
    t1.brand_code,
    t1.brand_name,
    t1.product_line_name
    ) p2 
  ON p1.category_p = p2.category_p
  AND nvl(p1.brand_code,1) = nvl(p2.brand_code,1)
  AND nvl(p1.brand_name,1) = nvl(p2.brand_name,1)
  AND nvl(p1.product_line_name,1) = nvl(p2.product_line_name,1)

-- 客户数量增量：本期实际产生sell-in销额的Customer总数与上期实际产生sell-in销额的Customer总数之差；客户平均销额：本期实际产生sell-in销额/Customer总数与上期实际产生sell-in销额/Customer总数之差；
-- 由于为下钻，客户数量需要去重，所以放在计算字段进行计算
-- 20210511变动原因，三级的客户出现重复导致数据不准确，不可直接使用三级客户数量求和一级，进行逻辑变动。
-- 20210923，使用树状筛选器优化参数

SELECT
  nvl(t1.channel_p,t2.channel_p) AS channel_p,
  nvl(t1.second_channel_name,t2.second_channel_name) as second_channel_name,
  nvl(t1.third_channel_name,t2.third_channel_name) as third_channel_name,
  t1.customer_id AS customer_id_now,
  t2.customer_id AS customer_id_mom,
  nvl(t1.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_now,
  nvl(t2.sku_ngs_amt,0) as sku_ngs_amt_mom
  -- nvl(t1.customers,0) as customers_now,
  -- nvl(t2.customers,0) as customers_mom
FROM 
  (
    SELECT
      b.channel_p,
      a.second_channel_name,
      a.third_channel_name,
      a.customer_id,
      sum(
          case when ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
    --   sum(sku_ngs_amt) as sku_ngs_amt
      -- count(DISTINCT customer_id) as customers   0511逻辑变动
    FROM  tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
        LEFT JOIN (
            select first_channel_name channel_p, first_channel_name channel_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by first_channel_name
            union all 
            select 'ALL' channel_p,first_channel_name channel_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by first_channel_name
        ) b
        ON nvl(a.first_channel_name,'') = nvl(b.channel_name,'')
    WHERE day in ( select time_now from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')     --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
    -- and if(sku_ngs_amt is null,0,sku_ngs_amt) !=0 -- 实际产生销额
    and case when ${'1':curr_type} then nvl(sku_ngs_amt,0) <>0
        when ${'2':curr_type} then nvl(ges,0)<>0
        end
    GROUP BY 
      b.channel_p,
      a.second_channel_name,
      a.third_channel_name,
      a.customer_id
  ) t1

  FULL JOIN 
  (
    SELECT
      b.channel_p,
      a.second_channel_name,
      a.third_channel_name,
      a.customer_id,
      sum(
          case when ${'1':curr_type} then sku_ngs_amt
            when ${'2':curr_type} then ges
            end
        ) as sku_ngs_amt
      -- count(DISTINCT customer_id) as customers
    FROM  tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu a
        LEFT JOIN (
            select first_channel_name channel_p, first_channel_name channel_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by first_channel_name
            union all 
            select 'ALL' channel_p,first_channel_name channel_name
            from tb_ngs_customer_product_channel
            group by first_channel_name
        ) b
        ON nvl(a.first_channel_name,'') = nvl(b.channel_name,'')
    WHERE day in ( select time_mom from sell_in_mapping_time where ${mapping_time:mapping_time})
    AND ${customer_id:customer_id}
    AND ${sku_id:sku_id}
    AND ${colour_hue:colour_hue}
    AND $condition{category_code,brand_code,product_line_name,sku_id:product}
    AND $condition{category_code,product_function,sub_product_function:p_function}
    AND $condition{product_pack_type,product_pack:p_pack}
    AND $condition{first_channel_name,second_channel_name,third_channel_name,fourth_channel_name:channel}
    AND $condition{henkel_region,province:region}
    AND region_customer_permission IN ('$tag{region_customer}')   -- 大区（字段）in该用户的region标签的值
    AND channel_customer_permission IN ('$tag{channel_customer}')      --  渠道（字段）in该用户的channel标签的值
    AND bu_2 IN ('$tag{bu}') -- bu_2（字段）in该用户的bu标签的值
    AND ${brand_code:brand_code}
    AND ${product_line_name:product_line_name}
    AND $condition{bu_1,bu_2,bu_3:bu}
    AND case when ${'1' : whether_pro_sample_product} then 'BI' = 'BI'      when ${'0' : whether_pro_sample_product} then   whether_pro_sample_product='0'     else  'BI' = 'BI'   end -- 选1逻辑：包含小样，既取全部数据，选2逻辑：不包含小样，既取非小样数据
    and case when ${'1':curr_type} then nvl(sku_ngs_amt,0) <>0
        when ${'2':curr_type} then nvl(ges,0)<>0
        end
    GROUP BY 
      b.channel_p,
      a.second_channel_name,
      a.third_channel_name,
      a.customer_id
  ) t2
  ON nvl(t1.channel_p,1) = nvl(t2.channel_p,1)
  AND nvl(t1.second_channel_name,1) = nvl(t2.second_channel_name,1)
  AND nvl(t1.third_channel_name,1) = nvl(t2.third_channel_name,1)
  AND nvl(t1.customer_id,1) = nvl(t2.customer_id,1)

SQL26.sql:
--MaxCompute_SQL
--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: sell in汇总表（sku粒度）
--功能描述: 到sku、客户粒度数据，每天更新全量数据
--创建者:mass
--创建日期: 2023-08-09
--修改日期  修改人 修改内容
--yyyymmdd  name  comment
--20240223  xueyang  统一所有BU的取数为同一逻辑，并增加GES字段
-- 20240312   xueyang   NKA渠道层级取值调整
-- 20240417   mass    专业线客户新增BU_3字段
--20240605  yyq     新增B2B&LKA渠道数据
--20241104  wpf   DECIMAL精度统一调整为(28,6)
-- 20250120 fei.he 调整按最新渠道取值
--20251229  mass  去掉tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary依赖
--20260228  shiwu  新增行级权限字段
--20260512   xueyang  增加字段合作状态、一级子品类中文、二级子品类中文、nes
--20260604   mass   添加区域、省份英文字段
--20260827   xueyang  Sales Order,Billing Type,Ship-to Party Code,PPD,PLD,FG,L6a Others
--********************************************************************--
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select
    a.customer_id              -- 客户id
   ,a.customer_name_en         -- 客户英文名
   ,a.customer_name            -- 客户名称
   -- 渠道转换需求，替换为最新的渠道相关字段字段
   ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_id         -- 一级渠道id
   ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name       -- 一级渠道名称
   ,a.second_channel_name_lastest  as second_channel_id        -- 二级渠道id
   ,a.second_channel_name_lastest  as second_channel_name      -- 二级渠道名称
   ,concat(a.first_channel_name_lastest,'-',a.second_channel_name_lastest) as second_channel_rename    -- 拼接一级二级渠道名称
   ,CASE WHEN upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('B2B&LKA','ECOM') THEN NULL
     ELSE a.third_channel_name_lastest END as third_channel_id         -- 三级渠道id
   ,CASE WHEN upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('B2B&LKA','ECOM') THEN NULL
     ELSE a.third_channel_name_lastest END  as third_channel_name       -- 三级渠道名称
   , concat(a.first_channel_name_lastest,'-',a.second_channel_name_lastest,'-',a.third_channel_name_lastest) as third_channel_rename     -- 拼接一级二级三级渠道名称
   ,CASE WHEN upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)='ECOM'
       OR (upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA') AND A.BU_2 IN ('SKP','SP')) THEN NULL
     ELSE a.fourth_channel_name_lastest END as fourth_channel_id        -- 四级渠道id
   ,CASE WHEN upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)='ECOM'
       OR (upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA') AND A.BU_2 IN ('SKP','SP')) THEN NULL
     ELSE a.fourth_channel_name_lastest END as fourth_channel_name      -- 四级渠道名称
   ,a.henkel_region_en_lastest as henkel_region            -- 大区
   ,a.province_en_lastest as province                 -- 省份
   ,a.customer_grade_mark_name as customer_grade_mark_code -- 客户类型分ABCD
   ,a.customer_grade_mark_name -- A类客户、B类客户、C类、D类
   ,a.product_id as sku_id                   -- 产品id
   ,a.sku_name                 -- 产品名字
   ,a.sku_name_en              -- 产品英文名字
   ,cast(a.sku_ngs_amt as DECIMAL(28,6)) as sku_ngs_amt  -- 累计销额
   ,nvl(a.quantity_consumer_units,0) as sku_quantity_amt -- 累计销售数量
   ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条形码
   ,a.henkel_category_code as category_code            -- 品类代码
   ,a.henkel_category      as category_name            -- 品类名称
   ,a.henkel_brand_code    as brand_code               -- 品牌代码
   ,a.henkel_brand         as brand_name               -- 品牌名称
   ,a.product_line_code        -- 产品线
   ,a.product_line_name        -- 产品线名称
   ,a.new_product_code         -- 新品(1新品，0非新品)
   ,a.new_product_name         -- 新品(1新品，0非新品)
   ,a.core_product_line_code   -- 核心产品线(1新品，0非新品)
   ,a.core_product_line_name   -- 核心产品线(1新品，0非新品)
   ,a.product_pack_type        -- 产品包装分类（一级）
   ,a.product_pack             -- 产品包装（二级）
   ,a.product_function         -- 一级子品类
   ,a.sub_product_function     -- 二级子品类
   ,case when length(a.colour_hue) < 2 or coalesce(a.colour_hue,'')='' then 'Others' -- 剔除把“ . ”替换为“Others”
    else a.colour_hue
   end ascolour_hue               -- 产品色调
   ,to_char(to_date(to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy') as year --年
   ,concat(to_char(to_date(to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',quarter(to_date(to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'))) as quarter --季度
   ,to_char(to_date(to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as month -- 月份
   ,a.ds as day -- 天
   ,a.bu_1    -- 业务条线一级(Retail/Professional)
   ,a.bu_2    -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
   ,a.whether_pro_sample_product   --专业线mini免费品标签(1是，0否)
   ,cast(a.ges as DECIMAL(28,6))  as  ges
   ,a.bu_3  -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   ,a.channel_customer_permission             --客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,a.region_customer_permission              --客户区域（权限字段）
   ,a.is_expired_customer                     -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭 
   ,a.product_function_cn                     -- 一级子品类中文 
   ,a.sub_product_function_cn                 -- 二级子品类中文 
   ,cast(a.nes as DECIMAL(28,6))            as nes   -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额 
   ,henkel_region                           as henkel_region_cn--大区中文
   ,province                                as province_cn--省份中文
   ,ship_to_party_code                      as ship_to_party_code    -- 送达方（客户编码） 
   ,cast(ppd        as DECIMAL(28,6))       as ppd            -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣

   ,order_id                                as order_id       -- 订单id 
   ,billing_type                            as billing_type   -- 计费类型 
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a

--MaxCompute_SQL
--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: SAP ke30数据
--功能描述: 数据记录的描述，如数据是什么、统计粒度等
--创建者: yuxuan.zhang_datacvg.com(yuxuan.zhang_datacvg.com@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2023-08-16 18:24:11
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--20231015  shiwu 8月份没有山姆的customercode,需要手工按产品从沃尔玛的客户中去拆开。L17指标由业务手工给到
--20240204  mass  profit_center_id调整对应的bu
--20240220  mass  Laundry 841310数据计算指标时剔除
--20240417   mass    专业线客户新增BU_3字段
--20240518  xueyang  调整BL的区分逻辑
--20240604  yyq     新增B2B&LKA渠道数据
--20240605  mass    调整202401月前后SKP、SP的取值逻辑;新增字段:sku_id,sku_name
--20240711  mass  调整BL的区分逻辑
--20240717  mass  调整sku_id取数逻辑
-- 20250120   fei.he 新增最新渠道字段
-- 20250305 mass   2025/1/1起，专业线SP的Profit Center由845520变更为845120
--20251105  mass  释放202506开始VS数据；释放Beauty Care数据；只取21年及之后的数据
--20260830   xueyang  增加字段Ship-to Party
--********v************************************************************--

--**取自SAP部分：
--**2024年07前：根据sales org+profit center划分
--**2024年07起：
--**Beauty Care：sales org为CNG1，profit center为841110，PH5前两位为非07
--**Laundry：sales org为CNG1，profit center为841110，PH5前两位为07
--**取自手工数据部分：2023年直取BU字段，2024年不区分

with ke30_temp01 as (
    select 
       substr(t1.company_code, 1, 4) company_code, --Company
       substr(t1.company_code, 6) company_name_en, --Company
       case when t1.year||substr('00'||regexp_replace(substr(t1.period,1,2),' ',''),-2,2) ='202308' 
         and if(t1.customer_code = 'Not assigned',t1.customer_code,replace(substr(t1.customer_code, 1, 11), ' ', '')) 
            in('703429','708859') and substr(t1.product, 1, 7) in ('2933659','2947051','2947460') then '2509858'
          else if(t1.customer_code = 'Not assigned',t1.customer_code,replace(substr(t1.customer_code, 1, 11), ' ', ''))
        end as customer_code,   --customer_code
       if(t1.customer_code = 'Not assigned',t1.customer_code,substr(t1.customer_code, 14)) customer_name_en,  --customer_name_en
			 if(prd_hirarchy_5 = 'Not assigned',prd_hirarchy_5,substr(prd_hirarchy_5, 1, 12)) product_code, 
       if(prd_hirarchy_5 = 'Not assigned',prd_hirarchy_5,substr(prd_hirarchy_5,14))     product_name_en,
       substr(t1.Sales_Organization_Code,1,4)          as Sales_Organization_Code, -- 销售机构代码
       substr(regexp_replace(t1.Profit_center_id ,'(\\D+)',''),5,6)       as Profit_center_id, -- 利润中心id
			 t1.year||substr('00'||regexp_replace(substr(t1.period,1,2),' ',''),-2,2) as months,
       replace(t1.l1, ',', '')      as  l1,   --L1 External sales qt
       replace(t1.l2, ',', '')      as  l2,   --L2 TOTAL Gross Ext.
       replace(t1.l3, ',', '')      as  l3,   --L3 Total Net Ext.
       replace(t1.l4, ',', '')      as  l4,   --L4 Total sales quant
       replace(t1.l5, ',', '')      as  l5,   --L5 Gross total sales
       replace(t1.l6a, ',', '')     as  l6a,  --L6a Discounts on inv
       replace(t1.total_net, ',', '') as  total_net,    --Total Net 1 (L5-L6a)
       replace(t1.l6b, ',', '')       as  l6b,  --L6b Discounts off in
       replace(t1.l6, ',', '')        as  l6,   --L6 Discounts
       replace(t1.l9, ',', '')        as  l9,   --L9 Net total sales
       replace(t1.l10, ',', '')     as l10,     --L10 Commissions
       replace(t1.l11, ',', '')     as l11,  --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
       replace(t1.l12, ',', '')     as l12,  --L12 Material cost
       replace(t1.l13, ',', '')     as l13,  --L13 Processing cost
       replace(t1.l14, ',', '')     as l14,  --L14 Total manufactur
       replace(t1.quantity_invoiced, ',', '') as quantity_invoiced,  --Quantity invoiced
       replace(t1.l15, ',', '')     as l15,   --L15 Product contribu
       replace(t1.l16, ',', '')     as l16,   --L16 Additional opera
       replace(t1.l19, ',', '')     as l19,   --L19 Utilization vari
       replace(t1.l18a, ',', '')    as l18a,  --L18a Gross Profit 1
       cast(replace(t1.l17a1, ',', '') as decimal(28,2))+cast(replace(t1.l17a2, ',', '') as decimal(28,2)) as l17a,  --L17a Advertising
       replace(t1.l17a1, ',', '')   as l17a1, --L17a1 Non-work media 
       replace(t1.l17a2, ',', '')   as l17a2, --L17a2 Non-work media
       replace(t1.l17b, ',', '')    as l17b,  --Z0170 Total L17b
       replace(t1.l17c, ',', '')    as l17c,  --L17c Market Research
       replace(t1.L17d, ',', '')    as L17d,  --L17d Intercom charge
       replace(t1.l17, ',', '')     as l17,   --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
       replace(t1.l18b, ',', '')    as l18b,  --L18b Gross Profit 2
       if(t1.Product='Not assigned',t1.Product,trim(substr(t1.Product,1,7))) as sku_id, -- 汉高产品编码
       if(t1.Product='Not assigned',t1.Product,substr(t1.Product,20)) as sku_name,-- 汉高产品名称
       if(t1.ship_to_party = 'Not assigned',t1.ship_to_party,replace(substr(t1.ship_to_party, 1, 11), ' ', '')) as   ship_to_party_code,           -- 送达方（客户编码） 
       if(t1.ship_to_party = 'Not assigned',t1.ship_to_party,substr(t1.ship_to_party, 12))                      as   ship_to_party_name_en,           -- 送达方（客户名称） 
       t1.ship_to_party         as   ship_to_party  -- 送达方（客户编码+名称） 
  from ${dme_ods}.s_sap_ke30_data_info t1 
  where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_sap_ke30_data_info')
  and substr(regexp_replace(t1.Profit_center_id ,'(\\D+)',''),5,6)<>'841310' -- Laundry 841310数据计算指标时剔除,剔除841310,L做内部销售
)

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke30_data_info_bu partition(ds)
select 
       substr(t1.company_code, 1, 4) company_code, --Company
       t1.company_name_en  as company_name_en, --Company
	     t1.bu_1,  -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
       t1.bu_2,  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
       case when t1.customer_code='未分配的'then 'Not assigned' else t1.customer_code end as customer_code,     --Customer
	   coalesce(t2.customer_name,'Others')     as customer_name,     --客户名称
       coalesce(t2.customer_name_en,'Others')  as customer_name_en,  --客户英文名称
       coalesce(t3.category,'Others')          as category_name_en,  --品类英文
       coalesce(t3.brand,'Others')             as brand_name_en,     --品牌英文
	     t1.product_code                         as product_code,      --ph5_code
	     coalesce(t1.product_name_en,'Others')   as product_name_en,   --ph5名称
       t1.Sales_Organization_Code        as Sales_Organization_Code, --销售机构代码
       t1.Profit_center_id               as Profit_center_id,        --利润中心id                 
       case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')
            then null else coalesce(t2.region_en,'Others') end   as region_en,      --区域英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除
       case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA') 
            then null else coalesce(t2.province_en,'Others') end as province_en,    --省份英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除 
       coalesce(t2.channel_name,'Others')         channel_name,    --渠道
       coalesce(t2.customer_group,'Others')       customer_group,  --客户分类
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_1,   --渠道层级第一级
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_2,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_2,   --渠道层级第二级
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_3,'Others') as   channel_hierarchy_3,   --渠道层级第三级
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_4,'Others') as  channel_hierarchy_4,   --渠道层级第四级	
       t1.l1,        --L1 External sales qt
       t1.l2,        --L2 TOTAL Gross Ext.
       t1.l3,        --L3 Total Net Ext.
       t1.l4,        --L4 Total sales quant
       t1.l5,        --L5 Gross total sales
       t1.l6a,       --L6a Discounts on inv
       t1.total_net, --Total Net 1 (L5-L6a)
       t1.l6b,       --L6b Discounts off in
       t1.l6,        --L6 Discounts
       t1.l9,        --L9 Net total sales
       t1.l10,       --L10 Commissions
       t1.l11,       --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
       t1.l12,       --L12 Material cost
       t1.l13,       --L13 Processing cost
       t1.l14,       --L14 Total manufactur
       t1.quantity_invoiced,  --Quantity invoiced
       t1.l15,       --L15 Product contribu
       t1.l16,       --L16 Additional opera
       cast(l17a1 as decimal(28,2))+cast(l17a2 as decimal(28,2)) as l17a,  --L17a Advertising
       t1.l17a1,     --L17a1 Non-work media 
       t1.l17a2,     --L17a2 Non-work media
       t1.l17b,      --Z0170 Total L17b
       t1.l17c,      --L17c Market Research
       t1.L17d,      --L17d Intercom charge
       t1.l17,       --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
       t1.l18a,      --L18a Gross Profit 1
       t1.l18b,      --L18b Gross Profit 2
       t1.l19,       --L19 Utilization vari
       case when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then nvl(t2.bu_3,'Others') end as bu_3,  -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
       t1.sku_id,  -- 汉高产品编码
       t1.sku_name,-- 汉高产品名称
 
        -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 start 20250108 ---
        case 
            when t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')
            then null 
            else coalesce(t2.region_en_lastest,'Others') 
            end   
        as region_en_lastest,      --区域英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除
        case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA') 
            then null else coalesce(t2.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en_lastest,    --省份英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除 
        coalesce(t2.channel_name_lastest,'Others')         channel_name_lastest,    --渠道
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,   --渠道层级第一级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_2_lastest,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_2_lastest,   --渠道层级第二级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_3_lastest,'Others') as   channel_hierarchy_3_lastest,   --渠道层级第三级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_4_lastest,'Others') as  channel_hierarchy_4_lastest,   --渠道层级第四级	
        -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 end 20250108 ---
       t1.ship_to_party_code,              -- 送达方（客户编码） 
       t1.ship_to_party_name_en,           -- 送达方（客户名称） 
       t1.ship_to_party   ,                -- 送达方（客户编码+名称） 
       t1.months   as ds  --月份  
from  (select t1.*,
            case when t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110','877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') then 'Consumer'
	             when t1.months < '202401' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','857080','845110','845520') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months>='202401' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months>='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'Professional'
               when t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506' then 'VS'
            else 'Others'    end as bu_1 ,   -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
	        
       case when t1.months < '202407' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110') and t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8620' then 'Beauty Care'
          when (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') <> '07') then 'Beauty Care'
	        when t1.months < '202407' and  (t1.Profit_center_id in ('877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8920' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110')) then 'Laundry'
	        when (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') = '07') then 'Laundry'
	        when t1.months < '202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
	        when t1.months >='202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
	      --  when t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8621' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months < '202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months >='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'SP'
          when t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506' then 'VS'
            else 'Others'   end  as bu_2   -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
        from ke30_temp01 t1
        where (t1.months < '202407' and (t1.Profit_center_id in ('877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') 
              or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8920' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110'))
              ) -- 取laundry 数据
          or (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') = '07') -- 取laundry 数据
          
          -- 取Professional 数据
          or (
            (t1.months < '202401' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','857080','845110','845520')) -- 取SKP\SP数据
	          or (t1.months>='202401' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110'))  -- 取SKP数据
	          or (t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520'))  -- 取SP数据
	          or (t1.months>='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120'))  -- 取SP数据
           )
           
          -- 取Beauty Care 数据
          or (
                 (t1.months < '202407' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8620' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110'))
	          or (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-')  <> '07')
           )
   
           -- 取VS的数据是2025-06-25才进入DME，所以需要限制months>='202506'
           or (t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506')
     
      --  or (t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038') or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8620' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110'))  -- Beauty Care 数据
       ) t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu t2
       on t1.customer_code= t2.customer_code
      and t1.bu_1 = t2.bu_1
      and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
      and t2.ds like '%01'
      and t1.months = substr(t2.ds,1,6)
      -- and t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
left join (
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,'Laundry' AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry')
       union 
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,bu AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional')
       union
        select
           a.ph5_code as ph5     --ph5编码
           ,b.category_name_en as category   --品类英文
           ,b.brand_name_en as brand         --品牌英文
           ,'Beauty Care' as bu_2
           ,row_number() over(partition by a.ph5_code order by a.priority1+b.priority2 desc) as rn
        from(
          select distinct 
            idh         --idh编码
            ,ph5_code   --ph5编码
            ,ph5_name   --ph5名称
            ,if(ph5_name is null or ph5_name ='',0,1) as priority1
          from dme_ods.s_master_data_product_idh_ph5_mapping 
          where ds = '${bizdate}'
         ) a
        left join(
           select 
            product_code    --产品编码
            ,category_name_en   --品类英文
            ,brand_name_en  --品牌英文
            ,if(category_name_en = 'Others',0,1) + if(brand_name_en = 'Others',0,1) priority2 --品类英文+品牌英文
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu 
           where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
           and bu_2='Beauty Care'
         ) b 
         on a.idh = b.product_code
     ) t3
       on t1.product_code = t3.ph5
       and upper(t1.bu_2)=upper(t3.bu_2)
       and t3.rn=1
  where t1.months >='202101' -- 只取21年及之后的数据
;

--MaxCompute_SQL
--********************************************************************--
--所属主题:  交易域 ke24销售表 (laundry、Professional数据）
--功能描述: 拼上客户、产品维度信息
--创建者:mass
--创建日期: 2023-08-09
--修改日期  修改人 修改内容
--yyyymmdd  name  comment
--20231121  mass  根据业务需求,23年8月按品的销售剥离出沃尔玛山姆会员；把Beauty Care的数据放出来。
--20240103  mass  profit_center_id调整对应的bu
--20240109  mass     WS渠道更名为MPD
--20240220  shiwu    调整Laundry的profitid的取值,剔除841310,L做内部销售
--20240229  xueyang  L6A相关指标2024年及之后 B&L逻辑调为一致
--20240318  shiwu    添加任务自依赖
--20240325  mass     新增产品基价字段
--20240417  mass     专业线客户新增BU_3字段
--20240507  xueyang  ke24新增字段
--20240518  xueyang  调整BL的区分逻辑
--20240604  yyq     新增B2B&LKA渠道数据
--20240605  mass    调整202401月前后SKP、SP的取值逻辑;新增字段:document_num
--20240711  mass  调整BL的区分逻辑
--20241031	xueyang	修改小数位精度
--20241151	xueyang	修改round保留精度
-- 20250120   fei.he 新增最新渠道字段
-- 20250305   mass   2025/1/1起，专业线SP的Profit Center由845520变更为845120
--20250420  xueyang s_sap_ke24_sale_info增加去重逻辑，根据document_num分组取导入时间最新的一份
--20250520  xueyang s_sap_ke24_sale_info更改去重逻辑，过滤创建日期小于当天，且创建日期与上传日期相等的数据
--20250623  mass    mid表新增23:30分钟批次
--20250714  mass    新增VS的数据，指标口径和专业线一致
--20250814  mass    调整VS的数据，BU_3取值
--20250901  xueyang 增加item相关字段
--20250910  xueyang VS的数据是2025-06-25才进入DME，所以需要限制create_date>='2025-06-25'
--20250924  xueyang PL逻辑统一，增加新字段
--20251103  mass    PL逻辑统一：调整ngs、ges指标口径，新增ges到nes PL指标；只取21年及之后的数据；合并KE30 Sales_Organization_Code 为'Not ' 或则'未分配'的数据
--20260202  mass    sellin支数量&箱数量调整为四舍五入
--20260203   mass    新增客户渠道、客户区域权限字段
--20260429   mass    下掉条件：过滤创建日期小于当天，且创建日期与上传日期相等的数据
--20260512   xueyang  增加字段合作状态、一级子品类中文、二级子品类中文
--20260827   xueyang  增加字段Ship-to Party Code 
--20260917  mass    调整产品主数据匹配逻辑，剔除bu关联条件
--********************************************************************--

--**取自SAP部分：
--**2024年07前：根据sales org+profit center划分
--**2024年07起：
--**Beauty Care：sales org为CNG1，profit center为841110，PH5前两位为非07
--**Laundry：sales org为CNG1，profit center为841110，PH5前两位为07
--**取自手工数据部分：2023年直取BU字段，2024年不区分

with
ke24_data_tmp as (
 select
   t1.customer_id -- 客户id
   ,t1.product_id -- 产品id
   ,t1.profit_center_id -- 利润中心id
   ,t1.plant_id         -- 工厂id
   ,to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd') as posting_date -- 过账日期
   ,to_date(substr(t1.invoice_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd') as invoice_date -- 发票日期
   ,t1.order_id              -- 订单id
   ,t1.reference_document_id -- 采购订单id
   --,cast(regexp_replace(t1.quantity_consumer_units,',','')    as bigint) as quantity_consumer_units  -- 产品销售数量
   --,cast(regexp_replace(t1.quantity_invoiced,',','')          as bigint) as quantity_invoiced        -- 数量

  ,customer_id
  ,product_id

  ,gross_sales_price+last_min_adjustmt_l5  as  ges
  ,product_promotion_discount*(-1)         as  ppd
  ,product_listing_discount*(-1)           as  pld
  ,ppd_free_goods*(-1)                     as  fg
  ,(- lmn_lma_line_6a
    +pxd_prod_except_disc+pxd_prodexcptobs_gds+pxd_prodexcptsusppr+lfn_prod_listing_fee
    +pvd_prod_volume_disc+qln_logistics_on_inv+ecn_process_service+cpn_cust_pick_on_inv+adn_promotion_bonus
    +abn_assortment_bonus+hqn_headqua_services+oln_othrs_line_6a+ton_terms_of_payment+cbn_imp_fund
    +ccn_cupn_cust_on_inv+din_inactive_2021+eun_agreement_bonus+ffn_flexibility_fund+lcn_inactive_2021
    +oon_inactive_2021+ornopenig_remod_fees+pdn_purch_chain_bdf+ped_inactive_2021+pld_pricelist_disc_2
    +pln_perm_listingfees+pmn_purch_chain_bmc+ppd_prod_prom_disc_2+ppd_outlet_rebate+ppd_promotion_rebate
    +ppd_trade_fairs+pod_prod_logist_dis+stn_inactive_2021+tfn_inactive_2021+frn_funding_rate
    +mdn_mdf_on_invoice+l6a_spe_equipmett+l6a_ib_area+l6a_ib_invoice)*(-1)   as  l6a_others
  ,(product_promotion_discount + product_listing_discount +ppd_free_goods - lmn_lma_line_6a
    + pxd_prod_except_disc+pxd_prodexcptobs_gds+pxd_prodexcptsusppr + lfn_prod_listing_fee
    +pvd_prod_volume_disc+qln_logistics_on_inv+ecn_process_service+cpn_cust_pick_on_inv+adn_promotion_bonus
    +abn_assortment_bonus+hqn_headqua_services+oln_othrs_line_6a+ton_terms_of_payment+cbn_imp_fund
    +ccn_cupn_cust_on_inv+din_inactive_2021+eun_agreement_bonus+ffn_flexibility_fund+lcn_inactive_2021
    +oon_inactive_2021+ornopenig_remod_fees+pdn_purch_chain_bdf+ped_inactive_2021+pld_pricelist_disc_2
    +pln_perm_listingfees+pmn_purch_chain_bmc+ppd_prod_prom_disc_2+ppd_outlet_rebate+ppd_promotion_rebate
    +ppd_trade_fairs+pod_prod_logist_dis+stn_inactive_2021+tfn_inactive_2021+frn_funding_rate
    +mdn_mdf_on_invoice+l6a_spe_equipmett+l6a_ib_area+l6a_ib_invoice)*(-1)   as  l6a
  ,(gross_sales_price+last_min_adjustmt_l5
     +product_promotion_discount + product_listing_discount +ppd_free_goods - lmn_lma_line_6a
     + pxd_prod_except_disc+pxd_prodexcptobs_gds+pxd_prodexcptsusppr + lfn_prod_listing_fee
     +pvd_prod_volume_disc+qln_logistics_on_inv+ecn_process_service+cpn_cust_pick_on_inv+adn_promotion_bonus
     +abn_assortment_bonus+hqn_headqua_services+oln_othrs_line_6a+ton_terms_of_payment+cbn_imp_fund
    +ccn_cupn_cust_on_inv+din_inactive_2021+eun_agreement_bonus+ffn_flexibility_fund+lcn_inactive_2021
    +oon_inactive_2021+ornopenig_remod_fees+pdn_purch_chain_bdf+ped_inactive_2021+pld_pricelist_disc_2
    +pln_perm_listingfees+pmn_purch_chain_bmc+ppd_prod_prom_disc_2+ppd_outlet_rebate+ppd_promotion_rebate
    +ppd_trade_fairs+pod_prod_logist_dis+stn_inactive_2021+tfn_inactive_2021+frn_funding_rate

  ,promotion_bonus_invoice                                 as   ka_expense
  ,lff_prod_listing_fee                                    as   listing_fee
  ,fff_flexibility_fund                                    as   promotion_activities
  ,logistics_invoice                                       as   logistics
  ,pxf_prod_except_disc                                    as   oos_penalty
  ,euf_agreement_bonus                                     as   int_agreement
  ,cast(0  as decimal(28,6))                               as   l6_adj
  ,dpf_deduction_provis                                    as   deduction
  ,rpf_returns_provisio                                    as   ror
  ,(hqf_hq_services + terms_payment + lmf_lma_6b +cbf_imp_fund+ccf_cupn_cust_of_inv
    +cnf_cupn_ntnl_of_inv+cpf_inactive_2021+dif_inactive_2021+ecf_process_servic+lcf_inactive_2021
    +oof_others_off_inv+orf_inactive_2021+pdf_inactive_2021+pef_inactive_2021+listing_fees

    +selling_effort+tff_inactive_2021+olf_othersl6b_fa+l6b_bonus) as l6b_others
  ,(ppf_prod_prom_disc
    +abf_assortment_bonus+gbf_growth_bonus
    +promotion_bonus_invoice
    +lff_prod_listing_fee
    +fff_flexibility_fund
    +logistics_invoice
    +pxf_prod_except_disc
    +euf_agreement_bonus
    +dpf_deduction_provis
    +rpf_returns_provisio+
    hqf_hq_services + terms_payment + lmf_lma_6b +cbf_imp_fund+ccf_cupn_cust_of_inv
    +cnf_cupn_ntnl_of_inv+cpf_inactive_2021+dif_inactive_2021+ecf_process_servic+lcf_inactive_2021
    +oof_others_off_inv+orf_inactive_2021+pdf_inactive_2021+pef_inactive_2021+listing_fees
    +pmf_inactive_2021+pof_inactive_2021+ppf_cash_tolerance+psf_prodpricelistdis+pvf_prodvolumedisc
    +selling_effort+tff_inactive_2021+olf_othersl6b_fa+l6b_bonus) as l6b
    ,ship_to_party  as  ship_to_party_code  -- 送达方（客户编码）

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu_mid partition(ds)
select
  case when  substr(t1.ds,1,6) ='202308' and t1.bu_2='Beauty Care'
    and t1.customer_id in('703429','708859')
    and t1.product_id in('2933659','2947051','2947460')
   then '2509858'
   else customer_id end as customer_id -- 客户id
  ,t1.product_id -- 产品id
  ,nvl(t3.product_barcode,'-110')               as product_barcode   -- 产品条码
  ,nvl(t3.sku_name     ,'Others')               as sku_name          -- 产品名称
  ,nvl(t3.sku_name_en  ,'Others')               as sku_name_en       -- 产品英文名称
  ,nvl(t3.brand_name_en,'Others')               as henkel_brand_code -- 汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
  ,nvl(bcconvert(t3.brand_name), 'Others')      as henkel_brand      -- 汉高品牌名称
  ,nvl(bcconvert(t3.brand_name_en), 'Others')   as henkel_brand_en   -- 汉高品牌英文名称
  ,nvl(t3.category_name_en, 'Others')           as henkel_category_code --汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
  ,nvl(bcconvert(t3.category_name), 'Others')   as henkel_category   -- 汉高品类名称
  ,nvl(bcconvert(t3.category_name_en),'Others') as henkel_category_en-- 汉高品类英文名称
  ,nvl(t3.product_line_code,'Others')           as product_line_code -- 产品线id
  ,nvl(t3.product_line_name,'Others')           as product_line_name -- 产品线
  ,nvl(t3.product_function    ,'Others') as product_function     -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(t3.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function -- 二级子品类
  ,nvl(t3.product_pack_type   ,'Others') as product_pack_type    -- 产品包装类型
  ,nvl(t3.product_pack        ,'Others') as product_pack         -- 产品包装
  ,nvl(t3.colour_hue          ,'Others') as colour_hue
  ,nvl(t3.new_product_code, '0')         as new_product_code     -- 新品 (1新品，0非新品）
  ,nvl(t3.new_product_name, '非新品')     as new_product_name     -- 新品
  ,nvl(t3.core_product_line_code, '0')   as core_product_line_code  --核心产品线 (1核心产品线，0非核心品产品线）
  ,nvl(t3.core_product_line_name,'非核心产品线') as core_product_line_name
 -- ,t2.henkel_region        as henkel_region       -- 区域
 -- ,t2.henkel_region_en     as henkel_region_en    -- 区域英文
 -- ,t2.province             as province            -- 省份
 -- ,t2.province_en          as province_en         -- 省份英文
  ,case when t2.channel_name = 'Ecom' then null
            when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')   then null
         else nvl(t2.henkel_region,'Others')
       end as henkel_region    -- 区域 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when t2.channel_name = 'Ecom' then null
            when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')  then null
         else nvl(t2.henkel_region_en,'Others')
       end as henkel_region_en -- 区域英文 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when t2.channel_name = 'Ecom' then null
            when t2.channel_name in ('NKA','B2B&LKA')   then null
        else  nvl(t2.province,'Others')
       end as province         -- 省份 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when t2.channel_name = 'Ecom' then null

            else nvl(region_lastest,'Others')
       end as henkel_region_lastest    -- 最新区域 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when channel_name_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
            when upper(channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')  then null
         else nvl(region_en_lastest,'Others')
       end as henkel_region_en_lastest -- 最新区域英文 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when channel_name_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
            when upper(channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')  then null
        else  nvl(province_lastest,'Others')
       end as province_lastest         -- 最新省份 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,case when channel_name_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
            when upper(channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
        else nvl(province_en_lastest,'Others')
       end as province_en_lastest      -- 最新省份英文 将Ecom与NKA中的Others 置为空
      ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_id_lastest    -- 最新一级渠道
      ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest  -- 最新一级渠道
      ,channel_hierarchy_2_lastest as second_channel_name_lastest -- 最新二级渠道
      ,channel_hierarchy_3_lastest as third_channel_name_lastest  -- 最新三级渠道
      ,channel_hierarchy_4_lastest as fourth_channel_name_lastest -- 最新四级渠道
      -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 end 20250108 ---
      ,customer_group_en_lv1 -- 客户分类Customer Group1(英文)
      ,customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
      ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
      ,is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01'
  )  t2
 on case when  substr(t1.ds,1,6) ='202308' and t1.bu_2='Beauty Care'
    and t1.customer_id in('703429','708859')
    and t1.product_id in('2933659','2947051','2947460')
   then '2509858'
   else customer_id end = t2.customer_code
 and t1.bu_1=t2.bu_1
 and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
 and substr(t1.ds,1,6)=t2.months
left join(
    select distinct
      product_code      -- 产品编码
      ,product_barcode  -- 产品条形码
      ,product_name     as sku_name      -- 产品名称
      ,product_name_en  as sku_name_en   -- 产品英文名称
      ,category_name                     -- 品类
      ,category_name_en                  -- 品类id
      ,brand_name                        -- 品牌
      ,brand_name_en                     -- 品牌英文
      ,product_line     as product_line_code -- 产品线id
      ,product_line     as product_line_name -- 产品线
      ,product_function      -- 一级子品类
      ,sub_product_function  -- 二级子品类
      ,product_pack_type -- 产品包装类型
      ,product_pack      -- 产品包装
      ,concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) as colour_hue
      ,nvl(new_product, '0')                                as new_product_code -- 新品 (1新品，0非新品）
      ,decode(nvl(new_product, '0'), '1', '新品', '非新品') as new_product_name -- 新品
      ,nvl(core_product_line, '0') as core_product_line_code  --核心产品线 (1核心产品线，0非核心品产品线）
      ,decode(nvl(core_product_line, '0'),'1','核心产品线','非核心产品线') as core_product_line_name
      ,bu_1  -- 业务条线一级(Retail/Professional
      ,bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP
      ,product_base_price -- 产品基价（未税）
      ,product_function_cn      -- 一级子品类中文
      ,sub_product_function_cn  -- 二级子品类中文
      ,ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
    where ds <> '1'
   -- and bu_2='Laundry'
  ) t3
 on t1.product_id = t3.product_code
 --and t1.bu_1=t3.bu_1
 --and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
 and t1.ds=t3.ds
 left join (
    select
      product_code,bu -- ,if(upper(trim(STD))='YADV',1,0) AS Sample_flag
    from ${dme_ods}.s_professional_product_sample_info
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_professional_product_sample_info')
    group by product_code,bu
 ) t4
 on t1.product_id = t4.product_code
 and t1.bu_2=t4.bu
 left join(--关联取到慢流品订单
    select distinct months,sales_order
       ,dense_rank() over(partition by months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as rn
    from dme_ods.s_profitability_slow_moving_mapping
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_profitability_slow_moving_mapping')
  ) a
  on substr(t1.ds,1,6) = a.months
  and cast(t1.order_id as  bigint)= cast(a.sales_order as  bigint)
  and a.rn = 1
where substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('0000','1000','2330') -- 只有0点、10点、23:30三个批次更新数据
and to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') >= '20210101' -- 只取21年及之后的数据
;
